the community-reported build (pobb.in/1PuQGhYCY9Fv): PoB's saved main skill is a zero-damage reservation buff; weapon-set-conditional passives and a real weapon-scaling attack skill (Voltaic Barrier, socket group 9) it does not select

Spell Totem proxy: the selected socket group is the Spell Totem meta skill whose totem casts Grim Pillars; PoB reports the totem's per-cast damage and cast rate on the player's main output, with player defences (Life, Energy Shield, resistances) measured separately

Mortar Cannon: the selected effect is Cluster Grenade, a per-use (show average) attack limited by its cooldown; PoB reports CombinedDPS as the per-use average and TotalDPS as the per-second rate for one totem, plus a separate totem limit

Siege Ballista: the saved main skill is a different grenade; the Siege Ballista group (socket group 9) is calculated with its second effect, Artillery, selected by the tests only, and carries the totem limit
Strength stacker: dual Brutus' Lead Sprinkler (Added Attack Fire Damage per 25 Strength), about 1,900 Strength, Chaos Inoculation; PoB's Str and ReqStr outputs and the per-25 threshold staircase
Dexterity/Intelligence stacker: Astramentis (all attributes) and Hand of Wisdom and Action (attack speed per 20 Dexterity, added lightning damage per 20 Intelligence)

Energy Shield scaling: the Eldritch Battery keystone converts all Energy Shield to maximum Mana and Rathpith Globe scales the Spell Totem's Spark with maximum Mana; PoB reports Energy Shield 0 and calculates Mana, damage and effective HP from the same pool

Gore Spike (node 52703 in tree version 0_4) scales critical damage with current unreserved Life; Original Sin plus 100 maximum Life raises Life, CritMultiplier, selected DPS, and EHP in PoB.

Energy Shield recovery: authentic pobb.in/K6bp-LNAo507 Invoker Spark build (R4 removed only the per-item GGG `Unique ID:` lines and the importing character hash). Boots gaining Energy Shield regeneration move EnergyShieldRegenRecovery from zero, a separate recovery channel from Life regeneration

Crossbow ammo effect pairing: a tester's public Maxroll export (maxroll.gg/poe2/pob/t77rg80g) whose saved main effect is the gem's "Load Permafrost Bolts" action; the bridge resolves it to the fired Permafrost Bolts effect so weapon replacements are measured (AMMO-01; sanitized: Unique ID lines, display cache and import character hash removed).
